content.title: WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026 results, live match coverage
content.text: The WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026 premium live event is going down tonight (Sat. Apr. 4, 2026) from the Factory at the District in Chesterfield, Missouri starting at 7:00 pm ET, live on YouTube (in the U.S.) and Netflix (everywhere else).CagesideSeats.com will provide LIVE blow-by-blow, match-by-match coverage of Stand & Deliver 2026 below, beginning with the first match of the evening and right on through to the main event.If you need any help getting up to speed on any or all of the action coming our way tonight, check out our preview & predictions.Kick your off your shoes, relax, and enjoy all the action with your favorite pro wrestling website. And remember to keep refreshing!WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026 QUICK RESULTSNXT Men’s Championship MatchTony D’Angelo def. Ethan Page, Joe Hendry (c), and Ricky SaintsNXT Women’s North American Championship MatchTatum Paxley (c) def. Blake MonroeNXT Men’s North American Championship MatchSingles MatchNXT Men’s Tag Team Championship MatchSwipe Right (c) def. Los AmericanosNXT Women’s Championship MatchPre-show Mixed Tag MatchProsper, Hank and Tank, Hill, & Sinclair def. Birth RightWWE NXT STAND & DELIVER 2026 LIVE BLOG & MATCH COVERAGEWeakened with fear, tried and condemned, the beast now prepares his ultimate offensive. The sun doesn’t shine, all faith is lost, silent holy man now will face his death, but me? I’m just here to liveblog this pro wrestling show for you, folks.Birth Right (Arianna Grace, Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo, Charlie Dempsey, Lexis King, & Uriah Connors) vs. EK Prosper, Hank and Tank (Hank Walker & Tank Ledger), Shiloh Hill, & Wren Sinclair (Mixed Tag Match)All-out brawling to start, setting down to Hank and Tank working Connors over, Ledger legal when the dust settles, Uriah plants a chop and tags Lorenzo in. Back body drop sends Connors to the floor, Tank off the ropes, Hank catches Stacks and chucks him to the floor and the Belly Boys are fired up!Channing back elbow, Connors tags in, he and Stacks double-team Walker on the floor! Back inside, tag to King, Hank on the wrong side of town for a good minute but he manages to low-bridge Lexis, back body drops for Stacks and Uriah, tag to Sinclair and so Grace must come in as well!Trading lariats, shoulder blocks, spin-out facebuster, do-si-do X-Factor into the Cattle Mutilation… DEMPSEY BREAKS IT UP! Schoolboy from Arianna for two, pump kick misses, spin-out X-Factor from Wren, tag to Prosper! Double dropkick clears the apron, dropkick takes out Lorenzo and propels a tornado DDT on Connors!EK a one-man wrecking crew here, fired up, Birth Right get the edge on him, a knee staggers him but Ledger breaks it up! Wren gets into it with Charlie, hurling huge overhand chops, butterfly suplex to the release! Codebreaker from Grace, women brawl to the floor, enzuigiri from Stacks, Bossman Slam from Hank! Lexis with a forearm, tilt-a-whirl slam from Hill, throwing Connors out too, Dempsey clobbers him from behind with an elbow!Prosper up top, big moonsault off the top rope, Ledger with a springboard shoulder block, tag to Walker! Belly Boys shirts off, fired up, Shiloh joins the honk honk, comes in after they sandwich Charlie…EK Prosper, Hank and Tank, Shiloh Hill, & Wren Sinclair win by pinfall with a back suplex neckbreaker from Hill on Charlie Dempsey.The main show kicks off with “Heartbreak Man” Shawn Michaels making his entrance and getting on the mic.He hypes up tonight’s show and introduces Sexyy Red.She greets the crowd and does the DX “We got two words for ya” bit with Heartbreak Man.And thence to the intro video.Jacy Jayne (c) vs. Kendal Grey vs. Lola Vice (NXT Women’s Championship)A shoving match breaks out between Grey and Jayne, Vice joins in and they together kick the champion to the floor! Kendal and Lola square up, Grey blocks a kick, schoolboy, cover for two. Pick the leg, Vice blocks, rolls through, Oklahoma roll from Kendal, quick covers, no pin. Fighting over a backslide, Jacy runs in, rolls into a double pin, only two!Kicking away at Grey, using her to kick Vice, Kendal with a waistlock, O’Connor roll for two, Lola tries for her own, Jayne shrugs her off and bowls her over! Kendal cartwheel evasion, ducking and dodging, double dropkick, cover on Vice, only two! Jockeying for position in the corner and to the apron, Jacy pulls Grey off to the floor and throws her into the steel steps!Lola takes Jayne out with a diving seated senton, a little shimmy,getting in Fatal Influence’s faces, back inside, Vice getting herself together. Whip-across short-arm kicks, arm drag from the champ, sidestep and Lola nails her with a body blow! Codebreaker from the champ so hard somebody pops out of their top and the screen goes black.Back up and running, Vice with a cover for two, into a reverse chinlock, bridging up, Grey comes in to break it up Jayne takes her out! Lola takes Jacy down, Kendal up and over, Jayne dropkicks her into Vice, stacked up, cannonball senton connects! Running kick gets the champ another nearfall over Grey, schoolboy returns the favor!Single knee facebreaker into a lariat from the champ… NOPE! Penalty Kick from Jacy sets up a senton, working Kendal over, up and jockeying for position, Vice comes from below… TOWER OF DOOM! Vice backs Grey into the corner with Speedball Kicks, takes Jayne to the opposite corner with more combination kicks, a shimmy, then hip attacks corner to corner to corner to corner and rubbing it in on the champ!Back suplex on Jacy, Kendal back in, she takes the straps down, throwing suplexes on both women, running knee from Jayne… VICE BREAKS IT UP! Jacy and Lola trading right hands, kicks, Vice is spent and she goes down to an enzuigiri but Jayne is feeling it! Off the ropes, Lola recovered… CRESCENT KICK HAS JACY DOWN BUT GREY BREAKS IT UP!Speedball Kicks on Kendal, la casadora blocked, catch a kick, crescent puts Grey down… JAYNE YANKS HER OUT OF THE RING! Penalty Kick lays Lola out but Jacy comes up lame grabbing her leg! Rolling ankle lock from Kendal when the champ returns to the ring! The screen blacks out, Jacy’s entire breast is just hanging right out of her top as Grey works her over in an ankle lock!Vice grabs a sleeper on Kendal, Grey has to let go of the ankle, bridging pin and into the guillotine choke! Back and forth, Kendal out-- the screen is going black in and out on me here it’s hard to call but Jacy looks to get lucky with a one-arm pin but Lola puts Grey’s foot on the ropes!Wren Sinclair dives on Fatal Influence, Jayne takes Vice out with a cannonball senton but her minions are nowhere to be seen! KENDAL GREY ORIHARA MOONSAULT! Throwing Jacy back inside, Grey off the top, diving DDT… VICE BREAKS IT UP! SLEEPER HOLD! KENDAL REVERSES BUT LOLA REVERSES BACK! Kendal on her feet, slamming into the ropes to break, Vice ducks the rolling elbow, Grey takes it, uraken… LOLA VICE DID IT!Lola Vice wins by pinfall with the uraken on Jacy Jayne, becoming your new NXT Women’s Champion.Los Americanos (Bravo & Rayo Americano) vs. Swipe Right (Brad Baylor & Ricky Smokes) (c) (NXT Men’s Tag Team Championship)Smokes and Bravo to start, collar and elbow, Americano gets a wristlock, Ricky reverses to a wristlock, reversed back to an arm drag! Baylor in, Los Americanos work him over with some double-teams, mounted punches from Bravo, Rayo tags in, diving seated senton, dropkick sends Brad flying! Double knees on Smokes, Americano backing Baylor into the ropes with chops, throat thrust, blind tag to Ricky, cover for two!Rayo up top, Smokes up with him, jockeying for position, Americano wrenches a finger to get an avalanche sunset flip, cover… NOPE! Tag to Baylor, brainbuster over the knee, cover for two! Big Saito suplex from Rayo, he’s down and out and reaching and clawing for the title, double-stomp cuts him off, quick tags from the champs!Dropkick-assisted spinebuster… NO DEAL! Tag to Bravo, big crossbody, flying headbutt, pop-up drop for Smokes! Back body drop for Baylor, huge double northern lights suplex from Americano! Hanging neckbreaker, swinging Ricky around before the release! Tag to Rayo, dropkick-assisted Michinoku Driver… BRAD BREAKS IT UP!Smokes turn around reverse STO into the turnbuckles, tag to Baylor, assisted Bossman Slam and a suicide dive… RAYO KICKS OUT! Brad untying Rayo’s mask, Americano fights him off with a kick, moonsault knee, Crash Landing… STILL NO! El Grande Americano Nuevo gives Bravo the metal plate and a headpat, he loads his mask and tags in.To the corner, Swipe Right get the better of him, assisted suplex… RAYO BREAKS IT UP! Ricky takes the metal plate and loads it into his crotch, Rayo powerbombs Baylor on the apron, Smokes takes him off the apron with a running knee, up top, Bravo wakes up and crotches him right on the steel! Splashes from Los Americanos… SMOKES KICKS OUT!Tag to Baylor, wishboning Rayo’s fingers to break a headlock, right hand, rebound lariat on Ricky, Bravo follows with a tope con giro, Rayo hits Drop Dead… SO CLOSE! Jackson Drake takes the metal plate from Smokes’ groin, Americanos take him out, Ricky gets the better of Rayo and shoves him to the floor, Drake cracks Bravo with a loaded punch with the crotch plate…Swipe Right win by pinfall with an assisted double stomp on Bravo Americano, retaining the NXT Men’s Tag Team Championship.Commentary recaps our preshow match.Shiloh Hill is backstage talking about how excited he is for his win with Tatum Paxley.She says that’s just the beginning, last year she won her first ever Stand & Deliver match on the preshow and look at the year she had! Shiloh gives her a pep talk.Sexyy Red appears and talks about how she’s gonna party with them later.Ricky Saints rolls up and says Red doesn’t want to party with these weirdos, because when he wins the title later she can party with a VIP.Sol Ruca vs. ZariaRuca on the attack before the bell, held back briefly and we get a bell! Sol with a surfboard stomp into the corner, double knees, backsplash caught, Zaria sets her down, leg pick and an elbow, superkick, Zaria slings her into the ropes and then drops her with a discus lariat! Bieling Sol across the ring, action to the floor and she smashes Ruca into the announce desk and the apron!Fireman’s carry, dropping her face-first across the steel! Back inside, catching Sol on a dive, fallaway slam… NOPE! Drawing her up, knees to the ropes, Zaria in control, surfboard stomp connects! Whip reversed, back body drop, Ruca rolls her through, double stomp, Zaria takes her down into grounded punches!Big German suplex, Zaria reasserting control, prowling after Sol, charging in, leapfrog, back elbow from the corner, up top, Ruca gets an avalanche Frankensteiner! Both women crawl to each other, face to face, talking trash, trading right hands from their knees and to their feet! Trading kicks, more right hands, overhead elbow and an uppercut set up a pair of back elbows from Sol and a German suplex out of the corner!Missile dropkick connects, kip-up, Zaria blocks a kick, fireman’s carry, Sol slips out, suplex over the ropes, Zaria tries to regain control but just crashes to the floor! Back inside, Ruca low bridges her, Zaria crashes to the ramp, catches a springboard, goozle, Sol slips out… SOL SNATCHER ON THE STEEL RAMP!Sol pulling herself together with the ropes, Zaria rising behind her… SPEAR THROUGH THE ROPES AND BACK INSIDE! Fireman’s carry, Zaria’s back gives out, another Sol Snatcher… ZARIA WILL NOT STAY DOWN! Sol off the top, caught with a lariat, Zaria with the fireman’s carry for the F-5… BUT RUCA ISN’T DONE YET EITHER!Zaria in control, Sol looking up desperate her, but she’s not having it! Headbutts after headbutts after headbutts! Fireman’s carry, up on the second, Ruca punching away and she manages to slip out. Jockeying for position… AVALANCHE X-FACTOR FROM SOL! SOL SNATCHER! IT’S OVER!Sol Ruca wins by pinfall with Sol Snatcher.Backstage, Lola Vice is walking with her title getting her kudos from crew members.Robert Stone congratulates her and says people will be coming for her but the ring will be hers on Tuesday to celebrate.Sexyy Red rolls up and Lola twerks with her for old times’ sake.Johnny Gargano vs. Myles Borne (c) (NXT Men’s North American Championship)Wristlock, Borne in control, to a top wristlock, shift to a side headlock, shot off, shoulder block, Gargano’s sleeping on the mat. Borne changes gears, pulls him up, and immediately eats an arm drag! Tijeras, dropkick, sending Myles to the floor, superkick off the apron, diving cannonball to the floor and Johnny Wrestling pops up and hugs Candice LeRae!Back inside, Borne with a hammer whip, Gargano takes the buckles with an incomplete Flair flip, whip across again, snap scoop powerslam, cover for two! Big backbreaker, backbreaker hold, Gargano mounts a comeback, out to the ramp, Superman Spear… NO DEAL! Myles takes him into the corner, rights and lefts, up top, Johnny slips under… CHEEKY NANDO’S!Borne out on his feet in the turnbuckles, Gargano with a sunset flip powerbomb… NOPE! Trading punches from their knees and to their feet, uppercut gets an enzuigiri, off the ropes, Myles with a dropkick, caught by a German suplex, buzzsaw roundhouse! Borne nails him with an Ushigoroshi… SO CLOSE!Out to the ramp, Myles with a dive, back to the ring, hanging DDT connects, One Final Beat… MYLES BORNE WON’T STAY DOWN! Superkick, back and forth, Borne Again… GARGANO KICKS OUT! Borne with a Boston Crab, Johnny counters to a pinning predicament, only two! Cheapshot from LeRae, schoolboy and tights… MYLES KICKS OUT! GARGANO ESCAPE! Rolling him around to stay on him, Borne crawling, reaching… AND HE GETS THE BREAK!Punches on the apron, Borne fires up, fireman’s carry, Gargano slips out, superkick, slingshot countered with an elbow, slingshot Borne Again connects, up for a third…Myles Borne wins by pinfall with Borne Again, retaining the NXT Men’s North American Championship.Post-match, Dion Lennox lays Borne out with a steel chair! Putting boots to him, Emerald Flowsion on the chair!Sol Ruca is interviewed backstage.She says she’s been in ladder matches, Iron Survivor, the Royal Rumble, but tonight against Zaria was her hardest match yet. They spent a year together but she proved her point and won and now she’s going for gold.Izzi Dame rolls up and tells Sol she’s not gonna just walk into another title match and says she’ll give her a few days to recover but the Great Dame is going for the same thing she is.Blake Monroe vs. Tatum Paxley (c) (NXT Women’s North American Championship)Paxley hammers Monroe with an elbow, single-knee facebreaker, charging in, up and over, big dropkick from the champ! Gory Special applied, bending Blake low into a pin, reverse surfboard applied, upkick from Monroe and a lariat, neckbreaker, cover for two! Grounded elbows connect, back suplex, Tatum lands on her feet, back suplex lift, hanging Blake in the Tree of Woe!Putting boots to her, charging in, corner crossbody connects, cover… NOPE! Monroe lays her out on the steel ramp, back inside, Blake working her over, arm-trap crossface applied, wrenching it in, Paxley fights out! Elbows, arm wringer, German suplex, fired up! Slide to the floor, pull Monroe over the ropes, enzuigiri from the floor!Back inside, somersault leg drop, cover… STILL NO! Both women down and out, trading kicks from the mat, both women getting fired up, vicious kicks, Tatum lays her out and goes up top, Blake sweeps her leg but she keeps it together! Monroe to the apron, enzuigiri, Paxley returns one of her own as Blake goes up top… SUPERPLEX AND TATUM ROLLS THROUGH INTO A SECOND AND THEN A FISHERMAN SPINEBUSTER FOR TWO!Wrist clutched, Monroe with a series of headbutts, throwing her into the corner, climbing on top, Paxley clutches her and powerbombs her! Out to the apron, Blake meets her with a boot… SUNSET FLIP POWERBOMB OFF THE APRON AND TO THE FLOOR! Back inside, cover… PAXLEY KICKS OUT! Monroe tears the pads off a pair of turnbuckles in the corner, Tatum slings her to the floor… BLAKE SMASHES HER WITH HER OWN TITLE BELT!Fireman’s carry slam for two, taking Paxley into the corner with the exposed turnbuckles, Tatum knocks her down, lands on her feet off a Frankensteiner, wide-eyed, rolling Koppu kick, charging, stop short of the turnbuckles, headbutt puts Paxley’s head into the turnbuckle! Glamour Shot connects… TATUM KICKS OUT!Monroe screams, DDT countered… CEMETERY DRIVE! IT’S OVER!Tatum Paxley wins by pinfall with Cemetery Drive, retaining the NXT Women’s North American Championship and regaining possesion of her title belt.DarkState are celebrating Dion Lennox’s attack backstage……except Saquon Shugars, who is upset Dion didn’t say anything and says he made a statement, not them, and they didn’t fly out here to watch him. He didn’t want to say this, but Lennox is starting to feel like he thinks he’s the leader or something. They’re not his lackeys, they’re starving, and he doesn’t mean anything by it, but it ain’t been seeming like they’re equals lately.Dion says he’s right, he should have told them, and y’know what, he’s got a plan for all of them to eat and he just wants them to trust him. Tuesday they go back to their roots and show the whole damn world when DarkState strikes.We get promos from Jasper Troy, Josh Briggs, and Keanu Carver ahead of their three-way match on Tuesday.Tatum Paxley is walking backstage when she runs into Hank and Tank and Shiloh Hill and EK Prosper who all celebrate her win with her while the Vanity Project look on in disgust.They chat amongst themselves when Blake Monroe rolls up and they ask if there’s anything they can do, and she says there is actually and tells them to come with her.“All Ego” Ethan Page vs. Joe Hendry (c) vs. “Absolute” Ricky Saints vs. Tony D’Angelo (NXT Men’s Championship)Saints and Page work together on Hendry for a long beat, D’Angelo comes to Joe’s aid and they send the heels packing before teeing off against each other! Hendry fireman’s carries Ethan, swings him around, throws him into Tony, scoops Ricky up, delay and the slam, cover for two! All Ego and Absolute work Joe over together, putting boots to him, charges into the corner and they pose together!Going back to Hendry, he fires off chops and uppercuts at them, they manage to get back on the same page, double vertical suplex, double cover but Page shoves Saints away! They argue over who gets to cover Joe and Ethan points out Tony D is coming back in. D’Angelo blocks getting put in the post by Saints but All Ego cuts him off and suplexes Ricky into him!Saints takes issue with being used as a weapon, Hendry clobbers them both with uppercuts! Whip reversed, back elbow, Codebreaker from Ethan, TKO from Ricky, they cover him together… NO FALL! Saints puts Joe up top, Page laying in wait on the next turnbuckle, superplex connects… ETHAN HITS THE DIVING SPLASH ON SAINTS AND SHRUGS!Mock apology, cover on Joe… SO CLOSE! Twisted Grin blocked, Saints spears Page, tornado DDT blocked, D’Angelo spears him! All four men down and out, Hendry first to his feet, All Ego a step behind, double leg, elbow drop on the champ! Working together with Saints again, each grabbing a single crab for a full Boston Crab, somersault double Stunner from Tony!Stacking the heels up in the corner, fireman’s carry neckbreaker on Saints, back body drop for Page, double clothesline sends them both to the floor! Hendry off the ropes, spinning spinebuster connects but All Ego pulls him out of the ring and he and Ricky throw D’Angelo into the steel steps so hard the steps slide about three feet!Dragging the steel steps over to the announce desk, Ricky with the tornado DDT on the floor! Twisted Grin on the floor! Big cannonball senton from Joe Hendry! Taking Page back inside, Saints lays Hendry out and saves his pal! Double suplex from the champ! Joe throwing lariats for everybody, whip reversed, big tijeras for All Ego! Fallaway slam on a returning Tony D, catching Saints on a dive, he fallaway slams him into Page to send both men to the floor!Standing Ovation on Tony D’Angelo… NO DEAL! Joe hammering punches at D’Angelo, Tony fired up, big right hand! German suplex follows, catching All Ego with a German as well, big belly-to-belly suplex on Saints, and it’s just to get him in position for a German suplex! Fisherman suplex into a small package on Ethan… HENDRY BREAKS IT UP!Joe with a DDT on D’Angelo, kip-up, step turn zoom smile, stomp stomp clap, Standing Ovation on Saints but Tony spears him before the impact! Sending Ricky to the floor, another spear… STILL NO! A chair in play, Saints counters the Standing Ovation, tornado DDT on the steel chair… ETHAN PAGE BREAKS IT UP!Page and Saints to the floor, trading big slaps into right hands, windmill punching, Ricky gets smashed into the steel! All Ego bridges the table cover to the apron, powerslam through the cover! Climbing up the steel steps, dragging Saints up with him, jawing at him… TONY D’ANGELO SPEARS THEM BOTH OFF THE STAIRS AND THROUGH THE DAMN ANNOUNCE DESK!Fired up, primal scream from Tony, back inside, off the ropes, float over Standing Ovation! Spear connects, chokeslam… IT’S OVER!Tony D’Angelo wins by pinfall with a chokeslam on Joe Hendry, becoming your new NXT Men’s Champion.Post-match, Tony D’Angelo holds the title high over his head while Joe Hendry collects himself in the corner.That’s the show, folks.512 Comments
